rule: Three continuous 375-second windows per source: start [0,375], centered [duration/2-187.5,duration/2+187.5], end [duration-375,duration]. Segment each window with existing 75-second anchors and authentic sentence boundaries; maximum 384 tokens. Prevalidate entire inventory before any annotation. If >31 units, do not annotate until budget-compatible preregistered boundaries are fixed without labels.
evaluation_scope: sampled continuous windows, not complete videos
